name: The Cake Incident
venue: Mwisho wa Mwisho Primary School Staff Room
description: The retirement cake for Mrs. Grace Njeri, Deputy Headmistress for 27 years, bore the name MRS. NJENGA in blue icing. Mrs. Njeri served the cake herself. No guest remarked upon the discrepancy.
prose: The retirement celebration for Mrs. Grace Njeri, Deputy Headmistress of Mwisho wa Mwisho Primary School for twenty-seven years, was held in the school staff room on the afternoon of 22 July 2016. Approximately twenty-three members of staff and two former colleagues attended. The occasion had been organised by the Senior Teachers' Committee and was scheduled to begin at 3:30 in the afternoon following the close of the school day. Speeches were given by the headmaster and two teaching colleagues. A cake had been ordered from a bakery in the district town on behalf of the staff.

The retirement cake, a round cake of approximately 25 centimetres in diameter, was brought into the staff room decorated in white icing with blue script lettering across its upper surface. The lettering read: MRS. NJENGA. Mrs. Njenga had retired from a school of similar designation in the same district the previous year. She was not present at the celebration. The name of the intended recipient — MRS. NJERI — does not appear on the cake in any form. The discrepancy between the name on the cake and the name of the person being celebrated was visible to all present from the moment the cake was carried through the door.

Mrs. Grace Njeri served the cake herself. She cut and distributed it to all attendees present. No attendee remarked upon the name on the cake. No attendee has, in any account subsequently given to the Heritage Trust, stated that they did not notice the incorrect name. The headmaster did not address the matter in his remarks, which had been delivered before the cake was brought in, nor did he return to the matter after the cake was served. The cake was fully consumed. Photographs taken at the celebration, prior to cutting, show the inscription clearly. These photographs are held in the Trust's documentary archive as DOC-2016-019.

The bakery from which the cake was ordered has not been contacted by the Heritage Trust. It has not been established whether the order was placed in writing, verbally, or by other means, nor whether the name MRS. NJENGA resulted from an error at the point of ordering or an error at the point of decoration. Mrs. Grace Njeri has not provided a statement to the Heritage Trust. She retired from the district and relocated to Nairobi in 2017. Her current contact details are not held by the Trust. This incident is closed.
heritageTrustNote: Mrs. Grace Njeri has not provided a statement to the Heritage Trust. The Trust notes, for the record, that no guest at the retirement celebration has offered an account of what they thought upon seeing the cake. This silence is itself part of the record.
